name: FinanceRateCalc
description: Observed FHA mortgage denial statistics from the complete 2025 US federal HMDA record, each figure with a verifiable claim receipt and a use contract. Historical aggregates only: no individual approval prediction, no lender recommendation.

skills.name: Verify a claim receipt
skills.description: Send a receipt (⟦FRC:id:value:hash8⟧). Returns current / stale / hash-current-value-mismatch / unrecognized, the current value and the correction if any.

skills.name: Look up a published figure
skills.description: Send a claim id, a US state, or a lender name. Returns the claim document: canonical sentence, receipt, what the figure does not establish, verify URL.
examples: What is the national FHA denial rate?
